newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia 1996 maize harvest falls to 1.1 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Russia 1996 maize harvest falls to 1.1 mln T.

text.p: Russia's 1996 maize harvest plummeted to 1.1 million tonnes, below 1995's 1.7 million tonnes, the State Statistics Committee said on Monday.

It repeated figures carried by Interfax news agency and reported by Reuters on January 17 that net grain output for 1996 had been revised upward slightly to 69.3 million tonnes from a previously estimated 69.0 million tonnes.
The committee, repeating previously reported figures, said 1996 winter and spring wheat output rose to 34.9 million tonnes from 30.1 million in 1995.
Barley output rose slightly to 15.9 million tonnes from 15.8 million in 1995, while rye output soared to 5.9 million tonnes from 4.1 million tonnes in 1995.
Oats output slipped to 8.3 million tonnes from 8.6 million, while rice production fell to 389,000 tonnes from 462,000 in 1995.
Russia's 1996 grain harvest was its second poor one in a row and the second worst on record for three decades.
